tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// bkra shis rtags brgyad kyi dbang bzhugs so//

bde chen zhing sgrub kyi dbang gi lhan thabs tshe dbang rgyas pa nas khol du phyung ba yod/ hūm̐ bkra shis gdugs kyis dbang bskur bas// slob ma rigs kyi bu khyaud kyis// chau+aus kyi gdugs bskor nus pa yi// dbang dang ldan nas tshe 'phel shog /oṃ a mi dhe wa hrīḥ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ: hūṃ bkra shis gser nyas dbang bskur bas// slob ma rigs kyi bu khyau+aud kyis// 'od kyis stong gsum khyab nus pa'i// dbang dang ldan nas tshe 'phel shog /oṃ a mi dhe wa hrīḥ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ: hūm̐ bkra shis dung gi dbang bskur bas// slob ma rigs kyi bu khyod kyis// snyan grags stong gsum khyab nus pa'i// dbang dang ldan nas tshe 'phel shog /oṃ a mi dhe wa hrīḥ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ: hūṃ bkra shis pad+mas dbang bskur bas// slob ma rigs kyi bu khyod kyis// 'gro ba srid las bsgral nus pa'i// dbang dang ldan nas tshe 'phel shog /oṃ a mi dhe wa hrīḥ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ: hūm̐ bkra shis bum pas dbang bskur bas// slob ma rigs kyi bu khyod kyis// chos kun khong du chud nus pa'i// dbang dang ldan nas tshe 'phel shog /oṃ a mi dhe wa hrīḥ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐ bkra shis dpal be'us dbang bskur bas// slob ma rigs kyi bu khyod kyis// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal skyob nus pa'i// dbang dang ldan nas tshe 'phel shog /oṃ a mi dhe wa hrīḥ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ hūm̐ bkra shis 'khor los dbang bskur bas// slob ma rigs kyi bu khyod kyis// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor nus pa'i// dbang dang ldan nas tshe 'phel shog /oṃ a mi dhe wa hrīḥ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ: hūm̐ bkra shis rgyal mtshan dbang bskur bas// slob ma rigs kyi bu khyod kyis// tshe ni nus par mi 'gyur ba'i// dbang dang ldan nas tshe 'phel shog /oṃ a mi dhe wa hrīḥ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐ nor bu 'khor lo 'di nyid ni// khyod kyi spyi bor bzhag pa yis// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor byas te// tshe yi rig 'dzin thob par shog

/oṃ a mi dhe wa hrīḥ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐ nor bu rin chen 'di nyid ni// khyod kyi spyi bor bzhag pa yis// bsam pa'i don kun 'grub gyur te// tshe yi rig 'dzin thob par shog /oṃ a mi dhe wa hrīḥ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐ nor bu blon po 'di nyid ni// khyod kyi spyi bor bzhag pa yis// snang srid dbang du 'dus gyur te// tshe yi rig 'dzin thob par shog /oṃ a mi dhe wa hrīḥ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐ nor bu btsun mo 'di nyid ni// khyod kyi spyi bor bzhag pa yis// dga' bzhi rgyud la skyes gyur te// tshe yi rig 'dzin thob par shog /oṃ a mi dhe wa hrīḥ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐ nor bu glang po 'di nyid ni// khyod kyi spyi bor bzhag pa yis// brtul zhugs che bar gyur nas kyang*// tshe yi rig 'dzin thob par shog /oṃ a mi dhe wa hrīḥ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐ nor bu rta mchog 'di nyid ni// khyod kyi spyi bor bzhag pa yis// brtson 'grus cher rgyas gyur nas kyang*// tshe yi rig 'dzin thob par shog /oṃ a mi dhe wa hrīḥ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ: hūm̐ nor bu dmag dpon 'di nyid ni// khyod kyi spyi bor bzhag pa yis// dgra bgegs tshar gcod gyur nas kyang// tshe yi rig 'dzin thob par shog /oṃ a mi dhe wa hrīḥ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: maṅga laṃ//
